name: Firewatch Ridge
summary: Dark Iron dwarves hold Firewatch Ridge above the Cauldron in northern Searing Gorge. Their sentries, golems, and fire spiders guard the bluff, while the Twilight's Hammer holds caves to the northwest.

sections.title: A Scorched Vantage Point
sections.body: From Firewatch Ridge, you look down on the Cauldron's industrial devastation. Dark Iron guards, engineers, and molten golems patrol the crags, defending their foothold beside venomous flame spiders native to the smoldering rocks. The height lets the Dark Irons watch the ash plains and spot incursions from Ironforge or the Thorium Brotherhood early.

sections.title: The Shadow of the Cult
sections.body: The Twilight's Hammer holds a cave network in the ridge's northwestern reaches. Its cultists work in the Dark Iron camp's shadow, performing dark rituals below the rock, where powerful elite zealots keep watch. The caves lie near both the Dark Iron works and Blackrock Mountain. Elemental and apocalyptic cults meet in Searing Gorge's fiery heart.

faq.answer: Firewatch Ridge rises above the Cauldron excavation in Searing Gorge, where the Dark Iron dwarves keep a major camp.
Hostile Dark Iron dwarves, mechanical golems, and native fire spiders inhabit the ridge. Elite Twilight's Hammer cultists hold the cave network to the northwest.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer here?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer occupies the ridge's northwestern caves to pursue elemental worship and apocalyptic rituals near Blackrock Mountain and the fire elementals bound in the region.

faq.q: How does Firewatch Ridge relate to the Cauldron?
faq.answer: Firewatch Ridge rises directly above the Cauldron, giving the Dark Iron dwarves a fortified vantage point to oversee mining and defend their quarry from attack.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you can see Firewatch Ridge as a grim reminder of your Dark Iron cousins' entrenched malice, iron industry, and dark alliances beneath Blackrock Mountain.
